scope: Post-open, result-blind re-adjudication of the already sealed v215 physical replay. The v215 Zero-CGLS K16 reference was inadequate, while the preregistered geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16 control was independently replayed and passed all 546 cells and all 13 complete rigs. This protocol fixes that adequate control as the sole reference before reading any proxy-versus-PCGLS matched result. It adds no physical replay, training, external generalization, resource benchmark, curved-ray validation, or real-BOST claim.
scientific_question: Against the independently adequate geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16 reference, does one globally fixed checkpoint of the v214 observation-only low-64 proxy followed by unchanged strict CGLS preserve all four absolute and matched-accuracy gates with fewer exact A and A^T calls, and is any such result explained by an equal-or-cheaper deterministic control?

known_before_freeze.reason: The v215-designated Zero-CGLS K16 reference passed 466/546 strict cells and 1/13 complete rigs; all 80 strict violations were interior-gradient-only.
unread_before_freeze: proxy-low64 absolute and matched gates relative to geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16
cheapest globally passing proxy checkpoint under the new reference
equal-or-cheaper deterministic-control dominance under the new reference

opened_scope.dataset: BLASTNet vitiated H2-air freely propagating flame DNS Case 5
opened_scope.role: already opened post-open mechanism-development data only

reference_and_candidate.selection_rule: Select the first globally fixed proxy checkpoint in the frozen order that passes every absolute and matched gate over all 546 cells and all 13 complete rigs. Per-cell, per-frame, or per-rig depth selection is forbidden.
reference_and_candidate.strict_call_reduction_required: Both exact A and exact A^T counts must be strictly below 16 for the selected proxy arm.

matched_accuracy_ratios.denominator: The corresponding geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16 metric, with a fixed 1e-30 numerical floor only to reject division by zero.

control_and_cost_contract.dominance_rule: A single globally fixed deterministic-control arm blocks proxy-specific headroom if it passes every absolute and matched gate and its exact A and A^T counts are componentwise equal to or below the selected proxy arm.
control_and_cost_contract.geometry_jacobi_setup_disclosure: The exact geometry-only diagonal setup recorded by v215 remains separate from logical online A/A^T counts; v216 makes no wall, RSS, or setup-amortization claim.
control_and_cost_contract.dual_ridge_and_neural_controls: Not applicable to this fixed zero-parameter proxy. They remain mandatory only after a separately frozen fitted observation-only predictor exists.

legacy_v215_validity_handling.rationale: Those false values are consequences of the obsolete v215 Zero-K16 reference designation. Every low-level replay, array, solver, call-ledger, parent, source, permutation, finiteness, and formal-independent comparison predicate must remain true.

independent_readjudication.formal_input: Only the sealed v215 formal metrics and exact-call arrays.
independent_readjudication.independent_input: Only the sealed v215 independently replayed metrics and exact-call arrays.
independent_readjudication.implementation_independence: The independent v216 program must not import the formal v216 adjudicator. It must separately implement absolute gates, matched ratios, higher p90, fixed checkpoint selection, strict-call reduction, control dominance, legacy-validity exception handling, and the decision order.

decision_order: Any sealed-parent mismatch, unexpected v215 false predicate, wrong arm order or shape, non-finite value, varying or mismatched call ledger, inadequate PCGLS-K16 reference, formal-independent summary drift beyond tolerance, input mutation, or decision mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_PCGLS_REFERENCE_WARM_READJUDICATION_V216.

If no globally fixed proxy checkpoint passes every absolute and matched gate, conclude FAIL_FIXED_LOW64_PROXY_WARM_START_AGAINST_ADEQUATE_PCGLS_REFERENCE_V216 and close this fixed low-64 proxy warm mechanism.
If the selected proxy does not strictly reduce both exact-call components below PCGLS K16, conclude FAIL_NO_EXACT_CALL_REDUCTION_AGAINST_ADEQUATE_PCGLS_REFERENCE_V216.
If an equal-or-cheaper deterministic control passes the same gates, conclude FAIL_CHEAP_DETERMINISTIC_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_PROXY_WARM_HEADROOM_V216 and close the proxy-specific advantage claim.
Only otherwise conclude PASS_CASE5_PROXY_WARM_HEADROOM_AGAINST_ADEQUATE_PCGLS_REFERENCE_V216. A pass is post-open Case5 mechanism headroom only.

stop_rules.on_proxy_failure: Close the fixed low-64 observation proxy warm-start mechanism; do not rescue it with a larger neural model.
stop_rules.on_control_dominance: Close the proxy-specific advantage claim; do not relabel a deterministic-control effect as learning.
stop_rules.on_pass: Freeze one unopened equivalent external gate before resource measurement or any broader claim.
stop_rules.on_inconclusive: Preserve all evidence and fix only the explicit validity defect; do not reinterpret partial values.
